Confirm the $250-after-$1,000 OneKey offer is still current on creditcards.wellsfargo.com before applying.

steps: Open Wells Fargo's official page https://creditcards.wellsfargo.com/no-annual-fee-credit-cards/ and confirm the One Key Card $250-after-$1,000 offer is still showing.
Complete the application; Wells Fargo runs a hard inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $1,000 on purchases you were already planning within the first 3 months.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance destroys the bonus.
The $250 in OneKeyCash posts to your Expedia-side rewards; use it toward a hotel or flight you were already booking.
